messages:
Nadia: quick follow-up from the pm: recurring proxy timeouts on dedicated clusters at 03:00. need owners + jira links so this doesn't fall through cracks.
Ben: I can own the mitigation and can put a hotfix flag behind a canary. who wants the deeper rca?
Luis: I9ll take RCA (proxy logs + connection churn). propose splitting work into: HOTFIX + RCA + monitoring playbook.
sre-bot: Incident auto-created: INC-2026-0503-09 1 proxy timeouts observed on dedicated. See: https://logs.redwood/INC-2026-0503-09
Clara: RACI suggestion: Responsible=Ben (hotfix), Responsible=Luis (rca), Accountable=Nadia (drive to close), Consulted=Platform team, Informed=Customer-Success.
Nadia: thumbs up. Ben, can you create JIRA tickets and set acceptance criteria? Link them here.
Ben: created REDW-9991 (hotfix: proxy connection backoff) and REDW-9992 (rca + monitoring). links: https://jira.redwood/browse/REDW-9991 https://jira.redwood/browse/REDW-9992
Luis: accepted REDW-9992. ETA: initial hypothesis in 4 days, full rca in 9. I will attach connection traces and a repro harness.
Ben: hotfix ETA: 48h for canary, rollback plan in ticket. acceptance: no timeouts on canary for 1h at 5% traffic, and no increase in 99p latency.
Clara: Add runbook steps for oncall in the ticket, and a temporary alert mute for noisy timeouts during verification.
Nadia: I'll update the postmortem doc with owners and RACI, and I9ll nudge PM to slot these into next sprint. weekly remediation sync: Fridays 9am until closed.
sre-bot: Reminder: link tickets back to this thread: https://redwood.slack/postmortems/3415000000. Auto-check in 24h.
Luis: quick checklist I9m drafting:
- collect tcpdump and proxy logs at T+0/T+15m
- compare conn reset counts across AZs
- run simulated open-conn workload for 2h
- validate connection pool settings in canary

Ben: will post PR and canary link once ready. pinging @Nadia and @Clara for verification.
Nadia: thanks all. please drop ticket updates in the postmortem and mark blockers early. :white_check_mark:
